description: Exact candidate interval indices for normalized physical and policy contexts; no beam identifiers, beam lengths, calculated demands, chosen layouts or solved results are stored.
context_source: Distinct physical contexts observed in the supplied model, then independently compiled for all finite nonnegative demands; these are exact reusable contexts, not model solution results.
matching: Complete normalized section, material, policy, hoop and candidate controls must match. Missing contexts require exact preparation.
limitations: Observed single-hoop contexts only; parent combined hoops and unseen or nonstandard conditions are not claimed.

files.source: Exact contexts collected during the L1 run preparation, prior to solving.
Exact contexts collected during full-input preparation, prior to solving.

compression: XZ (LZMA preset 6); JSONL index shards only
